flows.name: personal activity create, close, reload, reopen and diagnostics
steps: first entry shows 个人学习空间 without a school account, model or fixture
create an activity from a Chinese goal and multi-line question; detail shows the exact text
close the activity and observe the closed state
reload keeps the activity closed; reopening offers and performs 重新开始活动
?diagnostics=1 shows the runtime identity; the normal entry does not

flows.name: personal activity and identity survive a product stop/start
steps: stop and start the product daemon; the environment identity is unchanged
after restart the same identity can read the same activity; no new principal or space is created

flows.name: school account login, wrong password, activity and logout
steps: school entry shows the real account form
a wrong password is rejected with no session and no school identity
log in with the member created through xunjie school-member
create a school activity and confirm the multi-line Chinese text
reload keeps the school activity and it can be reopened
logout returns to the form, hides the activity and invalidates the old session

flows.name: membership revocation, regrant and old-session fencing
steps: an administrator revokes membership: the existing session and new login are rejected
regrant allows a fresh login; the pre-revocation session stays invalid

flows.name: installed client connects a school, writes through the proxy and revokes locally
steps: the installed client starts a connection with the school entry
the school authorization page logs the member in and approves the client
after completing the connection the school space is available
switch to 学校空间 and create an activity through the client proxy
the personal space cannot see or read the school activity created through the proxy
revoking the connection removes the school space and leaves zero local school-client-* grants

flows.name: administrator revokes one client connection without revoking the member
steps: a second client connection is established for the administrator test
the administrator revokes one connection; the member and their session still work, the proxy is denied
the client drops its stale local grant when the revoked entry is explicitly removed

flows.name: two members, two spaces and forged headers stay isolated
steps: a second real school member is created through the administrator CLI
two school members cannot read each other's activities
forged x-xj-space and identity headers cannot escalate access
personal and school spaces stay isolated

flows.name: Chrome IME composition and focus behavior in the learning form
steps: Chrome IME composition commits Chinese text into the goal field
composition then Enter inserts a newline in the question textarea and keeps focus

flows.name: macOS environment, private data directory and package independence
steps: product roots are private 0700 directories outside the repository
the packaged CLI runs from /tmp with only packaged resources and reports ready
the packaged product reports the native PostgreSQL binding

explanation.403: Two expected 403 responses from the revoked-connection proxy checks after the administrator/client revocation.
explanation.404: Two favicon.ico requests return 404 on the product web entry (cosmetic; no flow depends on it).

limitations: Both product environments ran on one Apple Silicon Mac over loopback HTTP; cross-machine networking and public TLS are not covered.
The client keeps a stale local grant after an administrator-only revocation until the user explicitly revokes that entry; the server denies proxied access immediately.

sourceRevision.note: Acceptance build produced from the production sources at this commit; the product package bundles the same source.
